state.project: CC - Hill View & Grassy Hollow Sub - CC Improvements
state.description: Build two 230kV switching stations (Hill View and Grassy Hollow) looping into the Cartersville - McGrau Ford 230kV line (8.5 miles apart). Build two new 230kV lines: Cass Pine - Great Valley and Great Valley - Grassy Hollow (total 10.1 miles) with 200C 1351 ACSS Martin.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and state are consistent with the project.
criteria.false: A different facility, e.g. a similarly named substation of another utility or in another state or region than the project describes.
